summary: CBS Sports' Week 13 NFL final injury report roundup by Tyler Sullivan, published Dec. 1, 2023. The headline items are Joe Flacco starting for the Browns against the Rams because Dorian Thompson-Robinson is out with a concussion, and Saints WR Chris Olave being questionable while in concussion protocol. It goes game by game through key injury designations, including Jonathan Taylor out for the Colts, Aaron Rodgers not being activated for the Jets, and Bengals and Jaguars updates for Monday.
one_line: Final Week 13 NFL injury report roundup: Flacco starts for Browns, Olave questionable for Saints, Jonathan Taylor out for Colts.
key_facts: Joe Flacco was named the Browns' starter against the Rams after Dorian Thompson-Robinson was ruled out with a concussion suffered last week against Denver.
Browns also ruled out WR Marquise Goodwin (concussion) and CB Denzel Ward (shoulder) vs. the Rams; C Nick Harris (knee) is questionable.
Saints WR Olave was a full participant Friday but remains in concussion protocol, per head coach Dennis Allen, and his status is up in the air.
Colts ruled out RB Jonathan Taylor (thumb) and CB JuJu Brents (quad) after both missed the entire week of practice.
Taylor underwent thumb surgery this week and is expected to miss at least a couple of weeks, giving Zack Moss a more prominent role.
Titans WR Treylon Burks is questionable with a concussion and must clear the final stages of protocol despite full Friday participation.
Jets QB Aaron Rodgers was limited again but will not be activated this week as he recovers from a torn Achilles suffered a few months ago.
Dolphins RB De'Von Achane was a full participant Friday and coach Mike McDaniel said he will play after missing time with a knee injury.
Eagles TE Dallas Goedert returned to practice Friday and is doubtful, his first practice since a fractured forearm against the Cowboys on Nov. 5.
Panthers ruled out TE Hurst for a third straight game and listed Tremble as doubtful.
Bengals WR Tee Higgins and LB Logan Wilson are set to play Monday against the Jaguars, per coach Zac Taylor, while CB Cam Taylor-Britt is out after hurting his foot in practice.
Jaguars RB Travis Etienne (ribs) is expected to play Monday, per Doug Pederson, despite being limited all week.
Lions designated rookie QB Hooker for return from a torn ACL suffered at Tennessee last year, but he was not expected to be activated this week.
